title: Qantas Business Class Tokyo Narita to Melbourne Tullamarine Direct One Way from $1,891.33 @ Fiji Airways
body:
Deal: Qantas Business Class Tokyo Narita to Melbourne Tullamarine Direct One Way from $1,891.33 @ Fiji Airways

[AircraftFreight] Overall this deal represents a great savings. If you were to book this through Qantas directly on some dates. Fares can be around 555,860 JPY or $5,103.89 AUD or 62.94% off.
One way fares for QF79 from Melbourne to Tokyo Narita can be found through Fiji Airways for as low as $3,301.93 AUD which still represents a great savings.
[AircraftFreight] "FJ 5339 operated as QF80 only on the overnight sector from Tokyo Narita to Melbourne Tullamarine"
Its QF80 direct from Tokyo Narita to Melbourne Tullamarine. Not Fiji Airways.
[perhaps] They use the a330's for that route right
[JacobAU] Need this deal this time next year haha wish I wasn’t already going to the USA
[AircraftFreight] If you wait it out, they are all heavily discounted even at the back of the calendar in September 2027 atm. Just hope the pricing is still the same.
[JacobAU] Yeah I mean I’m looking either for Japanese autumn/winter next year or something into 2028
[wengerboy] Seems like alot of Japan deals popping up.
[spock] Japan gets 40 million tourists a year i just got back so one more space .
[Herbs] Sorry, I'm in Japan now, I took your space. Japan's full again.
[LemonShapedRock] Possibly patched now, can’t see these fares?
[AircraftFreight] Still there for me. Make sure you are searching from Tokyo Narita to Melbourne on the Fiji Airways website.
[LemonShapedRock] Ah I see it now, had the airports the other way around
[AircraftFreight] I booked this offer for January 9.
Economy the cheapest fare price was $3,300~
Business the cheapest fare price was $5,500~
I paid $1,800 in the best seat in the house. Its pretty straight forward.
[icomeforthecomments] Have you booked and got the 120 SCs on a prior flight in a similar deal to this? Partner flights are only showing at 60 SCs so I was a little concerned?
[AircraftFreight] Sorry went through my activity statements and it is 60.
[icomeforthecomments] @AircraftFreight: Thanks for confirming. It's still great value, so thanks for posting!!
[retailsaver] @icomeforthecomments: Excuse my ignorance, what are SCs?
[AircraftFreight] With all due respect you are just factually wrong. Classic Reward Business redemptions are hard to come by, especially during peak season and yes you booked the points plane for 86,400 points and about $400 in taxes which is an average redemption overall.
And to address this line of "this is a deal for people who don’t know what they are doing"
This deal is actually better, once you include the taxes the effective cost of your redemption seat is calculated against a $1400 airfare which comes to 2.083c per point which is not a good value redemption rate for Qantas Classic Rewards in fact most Economy Domestic Reward seats offer a better price per point ratio. My average redemption rate is in the 5-8c territory per point.
[hawkeye93] comparing redemption to cash ticket, nice try diddy. Not everyone having points.
[madrooster] This is actually a fare filing error by Fiji Airways. The fare is intended to be NRT-NAN-MEL all on Fiji Airways. Fiji Airways don't have the traffic rights to sell the NRT-MEL Qantas flight on its own without it being combined with a flight to Fiji.
So be warned, Qantas can deny uplift as the ticket is in violation of traffic restrictions.
[AircraftFreight] https://www.iasc.gov.au/determinations_decisions/2018/2018ia…
Your statement is simply just incorrect. Fiji Airways has had the right to sell on Qantas operated flights between Australia and Japan with a codeshare since 2018 and renewed in 2021.
“the capacity may be used by Qantas to provide code share services with Fiji Airways in accordance with the code share agreement between Qantas and Fiji Airways […] and the air services arrangements between Australia and Japan.”
